description: This file defines a PHP class 'UserDecorator' that provides a wrapper or decorator around the 'User' entity, including methods for setting related entities like Employee and UserRole, and checking user roles such as 'Admin'. It also manages non-hashed password data.

classes.name: UserDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the User entity that provides additional methods to manipulate user-related data and roles, as well as accessing the underlying User object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a User object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee reference for the User based on the employee number.

methods.name: setUserRoleById
methods.description: Sets the UserRole reference for the User based on the role ID.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the User's role is 'Admin'.

methods.name: getNonHashedPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the non-hashed password stored in the decorator.

methods.name: setNonHashedPassword
methods.description: Sets the non-hashed password in the decorator.
